string.text: A welded steel range on a brick plinth, with a chimney, a prep shelf and a firewood rack. The Cook works here: it counts as a stove, so the Cook makes full meals instead of campfire food (with stove fuel in camp storage when the MCM fuel rule is on). Use it to open its storage: 300 kg of settlement storage for food and drink. Weighs 30 kg to carry.

A Soviet examination couch, wheeled IV stand, and instrument cart with medicine and surgical tools. The Medic works here: it counts as a medical station. Use it to open its storage: 300 kg of settlement storage for medicine. Weighs 28 kg to carry.

A fortified sentry station on a raised timber duckboard platform with a sandbag breastwork, warning sign, lamp, duty logbook, and an integrated 3-gun weapon rack. Guards stand watch here first, before the barricades and turrets. Use it to open its storage: 300 kg of settlement storage for weapons, ammo and grenades. Weighs 26 kg to carry.

A heavy steel teardown workbench with a timber top, zinc hammering plate, mounted Soviet bench vise, hanging hand tools, diagnostic multimeter, parts organizer bins, gooseneck lamp, and lower storage shelf. Scavengers wait here between expeditions. Use it to open its storage: 300 kg of settlement storage for tools, parts and salvage. Weighs 30 kg to carry.
